version.description: Schema version of this record. Currently 1.

updatedAt.description: Client time of the edit. Informational only; Nerd Ballot uses its own receipt time for deadlines.

rankedFilms.description: AT-URIs of com.nerdballot.film records, best first. No duplicates.

eligibilityYear.description: Release year of the films on the ballot.

main.description: One record per track. The record key is {award}-{eligibilityYear}-{category}, for example oscar-2026-picture or golden-globe-2026-musical-comedy. Array order is rank order: first earns 5 points, fifth earns 1.

description: A voter's ranked ballot for one Nerd Ballot film track. Nerd Ballot is an unofficial community poll, not affiliated with the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences or the Golden Globes.
